description: This file defines the 'RetrieveThingLiveCommand' interface, which extends other interfaces to provide live command functionalities for retrieving things in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It sets the contract for live command implementations related to retrieving and querying 'things'.

classes.name: RetrieveThingLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface for live commands to retrieve 'things', providing accessors and entry point for command answer builders.
